scripts.test: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-expense-splitter "node --test --test-concurrency=1 lib/__tests__/*.test.js"

scripts.test:store: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-expense-splitter "cd .. && flutter test integration_test/firestore_store_test.dart --no-pub --dart-define=FIREBASE_ENABLED=true --dart-define=USE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=true --dart-define=USE_FIRESTORE_DATA=true -d emulator-5554"
